Maya Patel: quick summary — ran a small bring-up for llamaX-3b quant (4-bit mixed) using speculative decoding with metaprobing heuristics. saw ~1.9x median token throughput vs baseline, tail latency still fine, but a subtle drop on CodeSynth-5k.
RJ: nice. what do you mean by metaprobing heuristics?
Maya Patel: short: probe top-k distribution early to decide whether to spec-prefetch next tokens. if prob mass concentrated, we spec; otherwise fall back. cheap entropy check at t+1.
Tom Lee: can you paste the exact command/env? makes repro easier.
Maya Patel: sure — running on a single p4d node, model compiled with kernel-v3, kv cache warm. quant backend: q4f (our internal). batch=8, max_new_tokens=512, temp=0.7, top_p=0.92. command: ```python run_infer.py --model llamaX-3b:q4f --decode speculative --probe-ent 0.28 --batch 8 --temp 0.7```
Sasha K: what probe threshold was that? 0.28 looks tight. how sensitive to threshold?
Maya Patel: tested 0.20/0.28/0.35. 0.28 gave best perf/quality balance on chat-bench; 0.35 cut more spec decisions -> lower speedup but higher consistency.
RJ: numbers? both throughput and eval metrics.
Maya Patel: quick numbers (median over 3 runs): baseline greedy q4f: 1150 tok/s; speculative-metaprobe @0.28: 2180 tok/s. CodeSynth-5k pass@1: baseline 42.6%, spec 40.1% — small hit, concentrated on long code completions.
Tom Lee: any hypothesis about the code drop?
Maya Patel: suspect probe misses multi-token idioms where local prob mass looks peaked but next tokens need wider beam; spec path returns earlier token without extra sampling. edge case for code.
Sasha K: can we do a hybrid: if sequence looks like code (heuristic by prefix or token classes), tighten probe or force fallback?
Maya Patel: already tried prefix-based gating; reduced regression to 40.8% but also reduced speedup to 1.6x. tradeoff seems workable.
RJ: how about eval methodology? use per-example paired comparison? random seeds?
Maya Patel: used fixed seed set, same prompt shuffles, and paired A/B scoring on 1000 samples per benchmark. we track logits distance, ngram overlap, and human spot check for top 200 code cases.
qa-bot: automated regression alert: CodeSynth-5k delta -2.5pp > threshold 1.5pp. filing ticket INF-4852.
Tom Lee: leave ticket but add a follow-up run with a slightly higher quant fidelity (q4f->q5f) to see if quantization interacts.
Maya Patel: plan: (1) rerun with q5f on same node; (2) add code-aware probe gating; (3) run 3x paired eval, collect per-token diff traces. target by EOD tomorrow.
RJ: thanks. also add a small ablation: disable kv warm to measure cold-start impact on probe decisions.
Maya Patel: yes, cold vs warm run scheduled. expected: speculative helpful only when kv warmed due to stable prefix probs.
Sasha K: FYI deploy-bot: canary slot 7 currently free if we want a small live smoke.
deploy-bot: canary deployed model=llamaX-3b:q4f-specprobe to slot=7, traffic=0.5% — monitoring logs at /canary/7190002468.
Maya Patel: ack. will watch latency traces and CodeSynth error spikes. anyone game to review quick eval artifacts later?
Tom Lee: I can at 4pm.
RJ: ping me after the q5f run.
Maya Patel: thanks all — will post numeric tables in the ticket and link traces. :thumbsup:
